spine.claim: Seldon has calculated the fall of the Galactic Empire and exiles the Encyclopedists to Terminus, where their fake mission keeps them unaware.
Hardin turns Terminus nuclear power into political leverage, playing the periphery kingdoms against each other without a fleet.
Belief itself becomes the Foundation weapon: a faith in its own authority that works as power.
The plan survives only while people act as if they are free, and a single exceptional individual threatens the statistical whole.
The crowd never sees its future; the drama is what the plan does to those who must act inside it.
